tours.title: East Coast Beaches
tours.subtitle: Sigiriya on the way, then the east coast's beaches in its dry months.
tours.short_desc: Sigiriya's rock, then the beaches around Trincomalee and the surf town of Arugam Bay, on the coast that is driest in the middle of the year.
tours.full_desc: The east coast has its dry season while the south and west have their rain, so this trip suits the middle of the year. It starts with a climb up Sigiriya, then spends most of its days by the sea at Trincomalee and Arugam Bay. Best from May to September. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Entry tickets and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: An early climb up Sigiriya
The beaches just north of Trincomalee
Koneswaram temple on Swami Rock
Arugam Bay, in its surf season

itinerary.title: Arrival and the drive to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive inland to Sigiriya. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: An early climb up Sigiriya, about an hour and a half with the gardens at its foot. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: To Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A drive east to Trincomalee. The afternoon is on the beach at Uppuveli or Nilaveli, just north of the town.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A free day by the sea, with time to visit Koneswaram temple on Swami Rock, above the harbour.

itinerary.title: Down the coast to Arugam Bay
itinerary.description: A long day's drive south along the east coast to Arugam Bay, with stops on the way.

itinerary.title: Arugam Bay
itinerary.description: A day on the beach. The surf season here runs from about April to October; outside it the waves are small.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back across the island to Colombo airport takes most of the day.

tours.title: Elephants, a Train and the Beach
tours.subtitle: Nine days for families: a rock to climb, a train through the tea country, elephants and the sea.
tours.short_desc: Sigiriya, Kandy, the train to Ella, a jeep safari at Udawalawe and two nights by the sea at Mirissa, with short drives and one main outing a day.
tours.full_desc: A route that keeps the days simple for children: one main outing a day, with time for a pool or an early night. The drives are split so none takes up a whole day. Best from December to March, the driest months in the hills and on the south coast. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Safaris, entry tickets and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: Sigiriya in the cooler morning
The train from Nanu Oya to Ella
A jeep safari at Udawalawe
Two nights by the sea at Mirissa

itinerary.title: Arrival and Sigiriya
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive inland to Sigiriya. The rest of the day is for settling in.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Sigiriya in the cooler morning: the climb has many steps, so take it slowly. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: To Kandy
itinerary.description: A drive south to Kandy, and an evening walk round Kandy Lake to the Temple of the Tooth.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: A morning at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Peradeniya, just outside the town. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: Into the hills, then the train
itinerary.description: A drive up to Nanu Oya, near Nuwara Eliya, then the train through the tea country to Ella. The line from Kandy is still being repaired after Cyclone Ditwah, so the train starts at Nanu Oya; if it isn't running, we drive.

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: A morning walk up Little Adam's Peak, a fairly easy climb through tea estates, and the walk to the Nine Arch Bridge.

itinerary.title: To Udawalawe
itinerary.description: A drive down to Udawalawe and an afternoon jeep safari. The park is known for its elephants, but wild animals can't be guaranteed on any one drive.

itinerary.title: To Mirissa
itinerary.description: On the way, the Elephant Transit Home, which looks after orphaned calves until they can go back to the park. The afternoon is on the beach.

itinerary.title: Mirissa and departure
itinerary.description: A last morning by the sea, then the drive to Colombo airport.

tours.title: A Short South Coast Family Trip
tours.subtitle: Six days on the south: a river, elephants, a beach and Galle Fort.
tours.short_desc: Bentota's beach and river, a jeep safari at Udawalawe, Mirissa's beach and a walk on the walls of Galle Fort, in six days with short drives.
tours.full_desc: A short trip that stays near the south and west coasts, with one inland day for the elephants at Udawalawe. Best from December to March, when these coasts are usually driest. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Safaris, boat trips and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: A boat trip on the Bentota River
A jeep safari at Udawalawe
The Elephant Transit Home
An evening on Galle Fort's walls

itinerary.title: Arrival and Bentota
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive down the coast to Bentota, about 65 km south of Colombo. The afternoon is on the beach.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: A boat trip on the Bentota River in the morning, and a free afternoon.

itinerary.title: To Udawalawe
itinerary.description: A drive inland to Udawalawe and an afternoon jeep safari. The park is known for its elephants, but sightings can't be guaranteed.

itinerary.title: To Mirissa
itinerary.description: The Elephant Transit Home in the morning, then a drive to Mirissa and an afternoon on the beach.

itinerary.title: To Galle
itinerary.description: A morning by the sea, then a short drive to Galle and an evening walk on the fort's walls.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive up the highway to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Tea Country, Slowly
tours.subtitle: A week in the hills: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Haputale and Ella, with the train between them.
tours.short_desc: Kandy, the tea estates round Nuwara Eliya, an early walk on Horton Plains, the views from Haputale and the train to Ella.
tours.full_desc: Seven days in the central hills, with no more than a few hours on the road each day. Best from December to March, the hill country's driest months. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Train tickets, entry fees and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: The Temple of the Tooth in Kandy
The walk to World's End on Horton Plains
Lipton's Seat above Haputale
The train from Haputale to Ella

itinerary.title: Arrival and Kandy
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive to Kandy, and an evening visit to the Temple of the Tooth.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: The Royal Botanic Gardens at Peradeniya in the morning, and a slow afternoon round the lake.

itinerary.title: To Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: A drive up through tea estates to Nuwara Eliya, with a stop at a tea factory on the way.

itinerary.title: Horton Plains
itinerary.description: An early start for Horton Plains: a 9 km loop on foot to World's End, a cliff with an 870 m drop, and Baker's Falls. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: To Haputale
itinerary.description: A drive to Haputale, then Lipton's Seat, the lookout above the Dambatenne tea estate, with views over five provinces on a clear day.

itinerary.title: The train to Ella
itinerary.description: The train from Haputale to Ella, on the stretch of line that reopened in June 2026. In the afternoon, an easy walk up Little Adam's Peak.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Rest on the Southwest Coast
tours.subtitle: Eight slow days: four nights at Bentota and three at Galle.
tours.short_desc: Two places and no early starts: four nights by the beach at Bentota and three inside or near Galle Fort, with time for Ayurveda treatments or yoga where your hotel offers them.
tours.full_desc: A trip for resting rather than sightseeing. There are only two stays, so you unpack twice, and most days have nothing planned. Many hotels at Bentota offer Ayurveda treatments and yoga; we can arrange them, or leave the days open. Best from December to March, when the southwest coast is usually driest. Included: a car and driver for the transfers, accommodation for the nights listed, and the drive between Bentota and Galle. Treatments and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: Four nights by the beach at Bentota
Brief Garden, Bevis Bawa's garden inland from Bentota
Early mornings on Galle Fort's walls
Days with nothing planned

itinerary.title: Arrival and Bentota
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive down the coast to Bentota. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: A free day. If your hotel offers Ayurveda treatments or yoga, this is a good day to start.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: A morning visit to Brief Garden, 11 km inland, the garden Bevis Bawa made on a former rubber estate. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: Bentota
itinerary.description: Another day with nothing planned: the beach, the pool, or a boat on the Bentota River.

itinerary.title: To Galle
itinerary.description: A short drive down the coast to Galle. The evening is for the fort's walls, when it's cooler.

itinerary.title: Galle
itinerary.description: An early walk round the fort before it gets busy, and a free afternoon.

itinerary.title: Galle
itinerary.description: A free day, by the sea or inside the fort.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive up the highway to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Quiet Days in the Hills
tours.subtitle: Eight unhurried days in Kandy, Haputale and Ella, with long stays and short drives.
tours.short_desc: Three stays in the cooler hills, with time to read, walk and rest, and Ayurveda treatments or yoga where your hotel offers them.
tours.full_desc: Slow travel in the hill country: three nights in Kandy, two in Haputale and two in Ella, with one short outing a day at most. We can book hotels that offer Ayurveda treatments and yoga, or leave the days open. Best from December to March, the hill country's driest months. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Treatments, train tickets and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: Three nights in Kandy
Adisham Bungalow and Lipton's Seat at Haputale
The train from Haputale to Ella
Short walks in the tea estates

itinerary.title: Arrival and Kandy
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive to Kandy. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: A slow morning at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Peradeniya, and a free afternoon.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: A free day, and in the evening the Temple of the Tooth.

itinerary.title: To Haputale
itinerary.description: A drive through the tea country to Haputale, about 1,400 m up. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: Haputale
itinerary.description: Lipton's Seat in the morning, then Adisham Bungalow, a 19th-century house modelled on Leeds Castle. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: The train to Ella
itinerary.description: The train from Haputale to Ella, on the stretch of line that reopened in June 2026. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: A free day, with a short walk to the Nine Arch Bridge if you'd like one.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Rivers and Ridges
tours.subtitle: A week of rafting at Kitulgala, walking on Horton Plains and hiking around Ella.
tours.short_desc: White-water rafting on the Kelani River at Kitulgala, the 9 km loop to World's End on Horton Plains, and the hike up Ella Rock.
tours.full_desc: An active week that climbs from the river at Kitulgala into the hills. Rafting runs with a licensed operator, and whether it goes ahead depends on the river's level on the day. The walks are on foot for several hours, on uneven paths. Best from December to March, the hill country's driest months. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Rafting, entry fees, guides and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: White-water rafting on the Kelani River
The walk to World's End and Baker's Falls
The train from Nanu Oya to Ella
The hike up Ella Rock

itinerary.title: Arrival and Kitulgala
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive inland to Kitulgala, on the Kelani River. The afternoon is free.

itinerary.title: Rafting on the Kelani River
itinerary.description: White-water rafting with a licensed operator, starting a few kilometres upstream of the village. The operator decides on the day whether the river's level is right. In the afternoon, a walk in the forest, where many of the island's rainforest birds live.

itinerary.title: Up to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: A drive up through the tea country to Nuwara Eliya.

itinerary.title: Horton Plains
itinerary.description: An early start for the 9 km loop on Horton Plains, to World's End, a cliff with an 870 m drop, and Baker's Falls.

itinerary.title: The train to Ella
itinerary.description: The train from Nanu Oya, near Nuwara Eliya, to Ella, on the stretch of line that reopened in June 2026. If it isn't running, we drive.

itinerary.title: Ella Rock
itinerary.description: The hike up Ella Rock: about two hours each way, along the railway line and through tea estates, and harder than Little Adam's Peak.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Rock Climbs and Surf
tours.subtitle: Nine days: Sigiriya and Pidurangala, hiking in the Knuckles, then surf at Arugam Bay.
tours.short_desc: Climbs up Pidurangala and Sigiriya, two days hiking in the Knuckles range with a guide, and three days at Arugam Bay in its surf season.
tours.full_desc: Rock, forest and sea, with a day set aside for the long drive from the Knuckles to the east coast and a day to rest after it. Surfing at Arugam Bay is seasonal: its season runs from about April to October, and this trip is for those months. Best from May to September, the east coast's dry season. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Guides, surfboards, lessons, entry fees and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: Pidurangala at sunrise
Two days hiking in the Knuckles range
A rest day after the long drive east
Surf at Arugam Bay in its season

itinerary.title: Arrival and Sigiriya
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive inland to Sigiriya. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Pidurangala and Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Pidurangala at sunrise, a 20 to 30 minute climb with a scramble over boulders at the top, about 1 km north of Sigiriya. Later, the climb up Sigiriya itself.

itinerary.title: To the Knuckles
itinerary.description: A drive south to the Knuckles range, and an afternoon walk with a local guide.

itinerary.title: Hiking in the Knuckles
itinerary.description: A full day on foot with a local guide. The range is part of a UNESCO World Heritage site, and its higher slopes are often in cloud.

itinerary.title: The long drive east
itinerary.description: A travel day: the drive from the Knuckles to Arugam Bay takes most of the day, with stops on the way.

itinerary.title: A day to rest
itinerary.description: Nothing planned after the long drive: the beach, and a look at the waves.

itinerary.title: Surf
itinerary.description: A day in the water, with a lesson if you're new to surfing.

itinerary.title: Surf
itinerary.description: Another day for surfing, or the beach.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back across the island to Colombo airport takes most of the day.

tours.title: Hills and Coast for Two
tours.subtitle: Nine days for two: Kandy and the tea country, then Mirissa and Galle.
tours.short_desc: Kandy, a night in Nuwara Eliya, the train to Ella, then the south coast at Mirissa and Galle, with evenings left free.
tours.full_desc: Five stays, with the long drives split so that most days have time to spare. The hills come first, then the south coast. Best from December to March, when both are usually driest. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Whale watching, entry fees and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: The train from Nanu Oya to Ella
Sunrise from Little Adam's Peak
Two nights by the sea at Mirissa
Evenings on Galle Fort's walls

itinerary.title: Arrival and Kandy
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive to Kandy. The evening is free.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: A slow day: the Royal Botanic Gardens at Peradeniya, and the Temple of the Tooth in the evening.

itinerary.title: To Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: A drive up through tea estates to Nuwara Eliya. Bring a warm layer for the evening.

itinerary.title: The train to Ella
itinerary.description: The train from Nanu Oya to Ella, on the stretch of line that reopened in June 2026. If it isn't running, we drive.

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: Little Adam's Peak at sunrise, a fairly easy walk, then a free day.

itinerary.title: Down to Mirissa
itinerary.description: A drive down from the hills to the south coast at Mirissa.

itinerary.title: Mirissa
itinerary.description: A free day by the sea. From about December to April, a whale-watching boat can go out from Mirissa; sightings can't be guaranteed.

itinerary.title: To Galle
itinerary.description: A short drive along the coast to Galle, and an evening on the fort's walls.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive up the highway to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Ancient Cities and the East Coast for Two
tours.subtitle: A week for two: Sigiriya and Dambulla, then four nights at Trincomalee.
tours.short_desc: Two nights at Sigiriya, with the cave temples of Dambulla nearby, then four nights by the sea at Trincomalee in the east coast's dry months.
tours.full_desc: Two stays only: Sigiriya for the rock and the cave temples, then the beaches round Trincomalee. Best from May to September, the east coast's dry season. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Entry tickets and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: An early climb up Sigiriya
The five cave temples of Dambulla
Four nights by the sea at Trincomalee
Koneswaram temple on Swami Rock

itinerary.title: Arrival and Sigiriya
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive inland to Sigiriya. The evening is free.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya and Dambulla
itinerary.description: An early climb up Sigiriya, then in the afternoon the Dambulla cave temples, about 19 km away: five caves with 153 Buddha statues and painted ceilings.

itinerary.title: To Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A drive east to Trincomalee, and an afternoon on the beach at Uppuveli or Nilaveli.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A free day by the sea.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee
itinerary.description: Koneswaram temple on Swami Rock in the morning, and a free afternoon.

itinerary.title: Trincomalee
itinerary.description: A last free day on the coast.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive back across the island to Colombo airport.

tours.title: Southern Parks and Whales
tours.subtitle: Six days: safaris at Udawalawe and Yala, then a whale-watching boat from Mirissa.
tours.short_desc: Jeep safaris at Udawalawe and Yala and a morning at sea off Mirissa, in the months when the south coast is driest and whale-watching boats go out.
tours.full_desc: Two national parks and the sea. Udawalawe is known for its elephants and Yala for its leopards, but these are wild animals and sightings can't be guaranteed on any drive or boat trip. Best from December to March: the south coast is usually driest then, and whale watching off Mirissa runs from about December to April. In recent years Yala, or some of its blocks, has closed for some weeks in September and October; the dates change each year, and we check them when you book. Included: a car and driver for the whole route, accommodation for the nights listed, and the transfers between stops. Safaris, the boat trip and anything else can be added: ask us.
highlights: A jeep safari at Udawalawe
Two drives in Yala National Park
The Elephant Transit Home
A whale-watching boat from Mirissa, in season

itinerary.title: Arrival and Udawalawe
itinerary.description: From the airport, a drive south to Udawalawe. The rest of the day is free.

itinerary.title: Udawalawe
itinerary.description: A morning jeep safari in Udawalawe National Park, where about 250 elephants live; sightings can't be guaranteed. Then the Elephant Transit Home, and a drive on towards Yala.

itinerary.title: Yala
itinerary.description: Jeep safaris in Yala in the early morning and late afternoon. The park is known for its leopards, but sightings can't be guaranteed.

itinerary.title: To Mirissa
itinerary.description: A drive along the south coast to Mirissa, and an afternoon by the sea.

itinerary.title: Whale watching
itinerary.description: An early boat from Mirissa, in season from about December to April. Blue whales are the large whales seen most often here, but sightings can't be guaranteed.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: The drive up the highway to Colombo airport.
